# Gaet

> Gaet is a command-line toolkit for PostgreSQL backup and restore. It dumps a local or remote database with `pg_dump -Fc`, validates the archive with `pg_restore --list`, keeps a timestamped snapshot, and restores the archive to the other database. A local dashboard and a TypeScript SDK wrap the same engine.

Key facts:

- Source and releases: https://github.com/ghaniyyrahmans/gaet
- Requires `pg_dump`, `pg_restore`, and `psql` on the machine that runs Gaet.
- Configuration is stored in `~/.gaet/.env` with `0600` permissions; snapshots and logs live in `~/.gaet/backups`.
- `gaet push` replaces objects in the remote database; `gaet fetch` and `gaet restore` overwrite the local database.
- Gaet is a snapshot tool, not a replication system. It does not stream changes or provide point-in-time recovery.
- The dashboard (`gaet serve`, default port 6161) has no built-in authentication.

## Documentation

- [Quickstart](https://gaet.ghaniyyirrahmans.me/docs/getting-started/quickstart): Install Gaet, run `gaet init`, and create the first snapshot.
- [What is Gaet?](https://gaet.ghaniyyirrahmans.me/docs/getting-started/what-is-gaet): How push, fetch, and restore move PostgreSQL data.
- [Installation](https://gaet.ghaniyyirrahmans.me/docs/getting-started/installation): Install scripts from the latest release, npm SDK, packages, and binaries for Linux, macOS, and Windows.
- [Configuration](https://gaet.ghaniyyirrahmans.me/docs/user-guide/configuration): Local and remote PostgreSQL connection settings.
- [Push a backup](https://gaet.ghaniyyirrahmans.me/docs/user-guide/push-backups): Dump, validate, snapshot, and restore to a remote database.
- [Fetch from a remote](https://gaet.ghaniyyirrahmans.me/docs/user-guide/fetch): Copy a remote database into the local database.
- [Restore a snapshot](https://gaet.ghaniyyirrahmans.me/docs/user-guide/restore): Restore the latest or a specific snapshot.
- [Automatic backups](https://gaet.ghaniyyirrahmans.me/docs/user-guide/automatic-backups): Schedule recurring backups with systemd, launchd, or Task Scheduler.
- [Troubleshooting](https://gaet.ghaniyyirrahmans.me/docs/user-guide/troubleshooting): Diagnose PostgreSQL tools, connections, authentication, timeouts, and locks.

## Reference

- [CLI reference](https://gaet.ghaniyyirrahmans.me/docs/reference/cli): Commands, flags, and JSON output.
- [Environment variables](https://gaet.ghaniyyirrahmans.me/docs/reference/environment): Every `GAET_*` setting, default, and legacy fallback.
- [REST API](https://gaet.ghaniyyirrahmans.me/docs/reference/rest-api): Endpoints exposed by `gaet serve`.
- [REST API responses](https://gaet.ghaniyyirrahmans.me/docs/reference/responses): Response shapes for status, snapshots, jobs, logs, and configuration.
- [TypeScript SDK](https://gaet.ghaniyyirrahmans.me/docs/reference/sdk): Client methods for the local HTTP service.
- [Security and safety](https://gaet.ghaniyyirrahmans.me/docs/reference/security): Credential handling, TLS, dashboard exposure, and destructive commands.
- [CI/CD integration](https://gaet.ghaniyyirrahmans.me/docs/reference/ci-cd): Non-interactive flags, exit codes, and pipeline checks.

## Development

- [Architecture](https://gaet.ghaniyyirrahmans.me/docs/development/architecture): Go packages and responsibilities.
- [Contributing](https://gaet.ghaniyyirrahmans.me/docs/development/contributing): Build, test, and documentation verification.
- [Updating and uninstalling](https://gaet.ghaniyyirrahmans.me/docs/development/lifecycle): Update or remove Gaet without losing data.
